title: The fuzz harness's own guarantees
note: R50 said the harness had no mutation matrix, unlike everything it tests. That matters more here than almost anywhere else: a fuzzer reports the same sentence -- no findings -- whether it exercised the whole package or nothing at all, so every guard that distinguishes those two is load-bearing and invisible. Z1-Z3 attack the refusal/finding distinction the harness rests on: a widened refusal set, a swallowed crash, a hang counted as a pass. Z4-Z6 attack the anti-vacuity machinery: the coverage floor that must FAIL rather than report, the feedback that must keep the declared seeds in play, and the sequence target's replay check which must sit outside the loop that tolerates refusals. Z7 attacks reproducibility, without which a finding is a rumour.

mutations.name: Z1_a_crash_is_reported_as_a_refusal
mutations.find:
except BaseException as exc:                    # noqa: BLE001 - the point
        return {"target": name, "kind": CRASHED,
mutations.rationale: every undeclared exception becomes a correctly refused case, so the campaign finds nothing by definition and says so in the same words it uses when it finds nothing honestly

mutations.name: Z2_a_hang_is_not_distinguished_from_a_pass
mutations.find:
except Hung as exc:
        return {"target": name, "kind": HUNG, "detail": str(exc),
mutations.rationale: a parser that never returns on attacker-controlled input is the one failure a timeout-based harness exists to see, and it becomes indistinguishable from a clean run

mutations.name: Z3_a_recursion_bound_is_treated_as_the_parser_s_own
mutations.rationale: the sequence target signals a broken invariant with AssertionError, and this reclassifies it as a note about interpreter nesting -- a finding filed under the wrong heading is a finding nobody reads

mutations.name: Z4_the_coverage_floor_reports_but_does_not_fail
mutations.rationale: the campaign prints how little it reached and exits zero, which is exactly the shape of every check that stopped checking

mutations.name: Z5_the_feedback_corpus_dilutes_the_declared_seeds
mutations.rationale: the first version of the feedback did exactly this: within a few hundred cases a valid record was the parent two per cent of the time, every case mutated something already broken, and coverage went DOWN

mutations.name: Z6_the_sequence_target_stops_replaying_what_it_built
mutations.rationale: a sequence of individually-refused operations can leave a perfect hash chain nobody can replay, and this is the check that would notice

mutations.name: Z7_the_second_reader_is_not_consulted_after_a_sequence
mutations.rationale: the two readers agreeing is what makes a rebuilt projection evidence rather than an assertion, and a sequence that made them diverge would pass

mutations.name: Z8_the_campaign_is_not_reproducible_from_its_seed
mutations.rationale: a finding nobody can reproduce is a rumour, and a campaign that cannot be re-run at the same seed cannot be bisected against a change

mutations.name: Z9_the_input_bound_is_removed
mutations.rationale: an unbounded mutation makes case cost unbounded, so the campaign's wall time depends on its own luck and a slow run is indistinguishable from a hang
